sources.entry: Calibre Web Automated - All-in-one solution, combining the modern lightweight web UI from Calibre-Web with the robust, versatile feature set of Calibre (fork of Calibre Web). GPL-3.0 Docker
Calibre-Web Automated | Calibre-Web with automatic ingest, conversion and metadata enforcement

summary.one_liner: Calibre-Web Automated is a self-hosted, Docker-deployed ebook library server that wraps the Calibre-Web web UI with automatic ingest, conversion, metadata enforcement and other extras drawn from full Calibre.
summary.what_it_does: Watches an ingest folder and automatically imports new ebook files into a Calibre library, converting them to a target format (EPUB by default, also MOBI, AZW3, KEPUB, PDF) when configured. It writes cover and metadata edits made in the web UI back into the ebook files themselves, so devices like Kindle receive the same metadata. It adds duplicate detection, rules-based "Magic Shelves", optional metadata fetching during ingest, auto-send to eReader by email, an EPUB fixer for Send-to-Kindle compatibility, and a KOReader progress sync (KOSync). It also includes a backup service, library auto-detect for existing Calibre libraries, batch editing, analytics pages, and OAuth 2.0/OIDC login. The README states it keeps all stock Calibre-Web features such as OPDS, Kobo sync and in-browser reading.
use_cases: Automatically importing and converting new ebooks
Sending books to Kindle or other eReaders
Cleaning up and deduplicating a Calibre library
Running a lightweight Calibre-Web alternative to containerised Calibre
how_to_run: Download the Docker Compose template with curl (URL missing from README text)
Move the compose file into an empty folder such as ~/docker/calibre-web-automated/
Edit the compose file to set timezone and volume binds for /config, /cwa-book-ingest, /calibre-library
Open the Web UI on port 8083 and log in with the default admin credentials, then change them
notable: Automatic ingest of ebook files dropped into a folder, with optional conversion
Enforces cover and metadata edits into the actual ebook files
Built-in KOReader sync server (KOSync) with HTTP Basic Auth
Network-share mode (NETWORK_SHARE_MODE) that disables WAL and switches to polling watchers
Auto-detects and mounts the largest Calibre library found under a bind
caveats: Default admin credentials (admin/admin123) are published in the README and must be changed
Downloading directly into the ingest folder is not supported; files in the ingest folder are deleted after processing
Supports only one library per instance
Acsm conversion requires an extra Calibre plugin; plugin configuration is not possible through CWA
